Maya R.: Heads up — noticed a spike in duplicate label jobs in the sampling reservoir after the quantized-ww2 bring-up. ~12% of batches contain hash collisions. Anyone else seeing this? @Ozgur
Ozgur T.: saw it. Looks like our shard seeding uses mod(hash) with the new tokenization, so seeds changed. We probably need stable-seed mapping between pre/post-quant models.
Maya R.: Yeah. This affects the labeling queue because the same examples get re-enqueued across microcohorts. Labeler capacity hit 70%.
Ria Patel: Is this causing golden set drift or just duplicate work? any quality regressions?
Maya R.: Mostly duplicate work, but a few examples were re-labeled with different instructions and caused small inter-annotator disagreement on toxic classification.
Sam K.: Quick fix: add a normalization pass before hashing (strip whitespace + standardize quotes + apply tokenizer-v1 normalization). Patch in sampling service? I can roll.
Alejandra G.: Also suggest adding a TTL on seed assignments so an item can't be routed to the same labeler group within 24h — reduces churn.
labeler-bot: INFO: requeued 148 examples from reservoir/shard-12 to labeling-queue at 2026-11-03T14:07:20Z
Ozgur T.: Sam + Alejandra good plan. One more: update dedup window from 7d->2d for microcohorting experiments, to protect against historic collisions during model bring-ups.
Ria Patel: For auditability — can we tag re-labels caused by sampling drift? We need to filter from evals.
Maya R.: Agreed. Add metadata field sampling_origin: 'reservoir-rotation' on requeued items.
Sam K.: I'll open a tiny PR to sampling-service and add the normalization + flag. Will also add `sampling_origin` tag. ETA EOD.
Alejandra G.: I'll update the labeler routing rules + TTL in ops runbook. Also adding a manual check to the onboarding checklist for quantized models: seed-stability test.
Maya R.: Thanks. Can someone run a quick backfill to mark duplicates from last 48h so we don't include them in the golden holdout evals? @Ria
Ria Patel: On it. Will produce a CSV of re-labeled ids and push to /mnt/evals/reservoir-drifts/ with a short summary.
Sam K.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampling-service/pull/431
Maya R.: :thumbsup: keep updates here. If we see quality regressions pop in the benchmark, let's freeze the microcohort for that model.
Ozgur T.: Noted.
